name: 75034 · Frisco, TX
findings: ZIP 75034 (Frisco) has 229 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75034 (Frisco) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75034 (Frisco) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
